Welcome.title: publishub tells you what to change in your video, second by second.
Welcome.lead: It watches the video, shows where it loses viewers and where it stalls, and suggests the cuts. Accept the ones you agree with and you get the edited video. What cutting can't fix comes in an ordered plan, for the editor you already use.

1.title: Send a Reel
1.text: Just the video file, exactly as you published it. Up to 500 MB. The retention screenshot from Insights is optional.

2.title: Wait about 3 minutes
2.text: publishub transcribes the speech, watches the frames and writes the action plan. You can leave the page: it keeps running.

3.title: Accept the cuts you agree with
3.text: Each suggested cut has its second. Accept them and download the edited video; do the rest of the plan in the editor you already use.

Welcome.note: Free to start. You'll see the drop second and the line you were saying before anything is asked of you.

faq.title: Before you send the first video
faq.q1: What do I need to send?
faq.a1: Just the Reel's video file (MP4, MOV or WEBM, up to 500 MB). You get the action plan from the video alone. If you also send the retention screenshot from Instagram Insights, publishub reads your real curve and adds a prediction you can check.
faq.a2: publishub needs a video with speech and a readable retention chart. TikTok shows that curve in its video analytics too; if the screenshot is clear, it works the same way.
faq.a3: Yes, monthly. Creator (US$ 12/month) and Pro (US$ 24/month) are subscriptions you can cancel anytime from your account, with no fee. And you can start for free.
faq.a4: You can test one video without an account and see the second people most likely leave, with the line you were saying. With a free account, your first analyses come complete: action plan, cut suggestions and rewritten hooks. After that, each analysis still shows where the video drops and its first recommendations; the full plan comes with any paid plan.
faq.q5: Does it replace CapCut or Premiere Pro?
faq.a5: No. publishub doesn't ask you to learn a new editor. It tells you what to change, at which second and why. You can download a version with the cuts you accepted, or apply the suggestions in CapCut, Premiere Pro or whichever editor you already use.
faq.q6: What happens to the videos I upload?
faq.a6: They're kept in private storage, reachable only by your account or our server through short-lived links. They're used to generate your analysis (the audio and frames are processed by Google Gemini for that), never sold and never used to train models of our own. Deleting your account removes your videos, screenshots and analyses right away.
faq.a7: Because a chat doesn't watch your video second by second. publishub transcribes your speech with the timing of every line, measures pauses and scene cuts in the file itself, reads your retention curve when you send the screenshot and points to the exact second of the problem. It also cuts: you accept the suggestions and download the edited video. And it remembers you: what you accept, reject and ask for becomes memory for your next analyses, while a chat starts from zero in every conversation.
faq.a8: It is if you post videos often, edit them yourself and want to know what to change before you post. It isn't if you rarely post or your videos have no speech, because the analysis starts from what you say. If you're unsure, test one video for free before paying anything.
faq.q9: Does it work for my niche?
faq.a9: It works in any niche where you talk on camera: personal brand, education, business, beauty, cooking, fitness, UGC and so on. publishub analyzes speech, pacing and viewer attention, which apply to all of them. Music-only videos, with no speech, aren't analyzed yet.
faq.q10: What if I don't like it?
faq.a10: Cancel anytime from your account: you keep access until the end of the month you paid for, and you won't be charged again. And before paying, you can test it on your own video, for free.
faq.a11: An AI editing copilot for short videos with speech, made for freelance editors, UGC creators and creators who edit their own videos. You upload a Reel, TikTok or Short and publishub watches it second by second: it transcribes what you say, measures pauses and scene changes, and leaves editing notes with the second and the reason for each one. It doesn't edit on its own or replace your editor. You decide what changes.
faq.q12: Which editing apps does it work with?
faq.a12: Any app that exports MP4, MOV or WEBM: CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, your phone's built-in editor and so on. publishub doesn't plug into these apps. It works with the file you export (up to 500 MB), and you apply the notes back in your editor.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This explains what data publishub collects, why, and what you can do about it. Written to be read, not to hide behind jargon.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: From your account: your email and, if you want, a name. From your use: the videos and screenshots you send, the transcript and analysis we generate from them, and usage events (which screen opened, whether the analysis finished, whether a payment went through) with none of what you say in the video. From payment: Stripe processes the card; we keep only the record that the purchase happened, the amount and the email used. Without an account: if you ask for the analysis by email, we keep the email, the analysis it refers to and the site's language.

sections.title: What we use it for
sections.body: To generate your analysis, keep your history, charge you when you buy, send the 72-hour reminder if you ask for it, and understand where the product fails. We don't sell any data and we don't use your video to train models of our own. The email asked for on a free analysis is only used to send that analysis, with the link to open the full plan.

sections.title: Who we share it with
sections.body: Supabase (database, login and file storage), Google Gemini (processes the audio and frames to generate the analysis), Stripe (payment), Resend (the reminder and analysis emails), PostHog (usage metrics: which steps of the site were used, never the video's content or your email) and, only if you connect it, Notion (receives the analysis as text, never the video). Each one gets only what its part needs.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: As long as your account exists. Deleting your account removes the videos, screenshots, analyses and the login; the tax record of a purchase stays for the period the law requires, unlinked from your identity.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can see, correct and delete your data. Deletion lives on your account page and is immediate. If you'd rather, write to support and we'll do it for you.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: We use the Supabase session cookie (to keep you signed in) and a language cookie (to remember which language you chose). PostHog stores a random identifier in the browser to count how the site is used: pages viewed and the funnel steps (video upload, email request, checkout click and purchase). We don't record your screen, we don't capture what you type and we don't use social pixels.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Files sit in private storage, reachable only by your account or our server, through short-lived links. The access to an account you connect (such as Notion) is encrypted before being stored.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Privacy questions, deletion or a copy of your data: write to support at the address in the footer of this page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: The rules for using publishub. Creating an account means you agree to them.

sections.title: What publishub does
sections.body: publishub analyzes short videos and returns recommendations: the second your audience drops, the line you were saying at it, and an action plan of what to cut, change, add and improve. It also generates an edited version of the video, with the cuts the analysis suggests or that you ask for, without ever changing the file you uploaded. publishub does not guarantee audience, reach or results: the recommendations and the edits are analysis, not a promise.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: You are responsible for keeping access to your account safe. Use publishub if you are 18 or older, or with permission from whoever is responsible for you.

sections.title: Your content
sections.body: Your videos stay yours. You give us permission to process them for the single purpose of generating your analysis and showing you the result. Don't send illegal content, or material from others that you have no right to.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Don't try to get around usage limits, automate sign-ups or overload the service. Accounts doing that can be suspended.

sections.title: Fair use
sections.body: Unlimited analyses means no limit on videos over time, not no limit at all. To keep the service fast for everyone, each account can send up to 20 videos for analysis every 24 hours. The limit applies to every account, free or paid, and frees up 24 hours after each upload. Retrying an analysis that failed does not count. We may raise this number at any time; if we ever need to lower it, we will tell you first.

sections.title: Payment
sections.body: Paid plans are processed by Stripe and unlock full analyses, the edited video and the action plan. Creator and Pro are monthly subscriptions: they are charged when you subscribe and then every month until you cancel. You can cancel at any time from your account page; the plan stays active until the end of the period already paid and is not charged again. Founder Lifetime is a one-time payment, not a subscription. It is sold only to the first buyers, up to the number of spots shown on the site; once the spots run out, sales close. "Lifetime" means as long as publishub exists as a service. If something goes wrong with your purchase, write to support: we refund within the legal cooling-off period.

sections.title: Availability and changes
sections.body: The service can have downtime, and features can change. Changes that take something meaningful away from people who already paid will be announced by email.

sections.title: Limit of liability
sections.body: publishub is provided as is. We're not responsible for editorial decisions you make from the recommendations, nor for reach results on the platforms where you publish.

sections.title: Ending and governing law
sections.body: You can delete your account whenever you want, from the account page. These terms follow Brazilian law.

steps: Upload the edited video (MP4, MOV or WEBM).
publishub transcribes the speech, measures pauses and scene changes in the file and reads frames of the video.
